_meta.purpose: Structured record of the YouTube / TikTok / Instagram links attached to each restaurant and activity, including what kind of page each link actually is. The site previously shipped 261 search or hashtag URLs and labelled them review links; this file separates a specific post from a search page so a reader knows which one they are clicking.

link_kinds.specific-video: a single YouTube video whose title and description name this venue; opened in this session
link_kinds.specific-short: a single YouTube Short whose title names this venue; seen on the venue's search results page this session
link_kinds.specific-tiktok: a single TikTok post verified in an earlier session
link_kinds.search: a results page that runs a query; it may show any venue and can change at any time
link_kinds.channel: a verified official venue or publication channel, not a review of one visit

coverage.notes: A specific link exists where a title unambiguously names the venue. Where the only available material was a search page, that is recorded as 'search' rather than dressed up as a review.

_meta.rule: A link is listed as specific only when its own title or description names the venue and the page was opened in this session. Views, uploaders and titles below are transcribed from the page as fetched.
